newsitem.title: USA: Harrah's Reno casino reopens after flooding.
newsitem.headline: Harrah's Reno casino reopens after flooding.

text.p: Harrah's Entertainment Inc on Friday said it reopened its hotel and casino in Reno, Nevada, after heavy rains and flooding from the Truckee River forced its closure the previous afternoon.
"There was no permanent damage and only a little water in the basement, which was pumped out," a spokesman told Reuters.

Elsewhere, two properties owned by Hilton Hotels Corp -- the Reno Hilton near the airport and the Flamingo Hilton downtown -- remained opened through the flooding and showed no signs of interior damage, a spokeswoman said.
Circus Circus Enterprises Inc's Circus Circus - Reno also stayed open without any apparent damage, as did the Silver Legacy hotel/casino, which is 50 percent owned by Circus Circus.

Representatives of Circus Circus and Hilton said business actually picked up during the past two nights as the inclement weather forced many holiday visitors to stay in the city longer than they had planned.
Current weather forecasts for the Reno area call for only scattered showers as the flooding begins to subside. The Reno airport remains closed, as do many roads in and around the city.
